info.title: Subject Advisors UC20 Forecast Planning API
info.description: PLANNED contract only. These endpoints are not implemented. Uploaded people are external-reference cohorts and are never linked to portal students or profiles. Product owner rules 2026-11-01 (S2-P004-006): finalizing a forecast publishes nothing; the Coordinator then CONFIRMS offerings per programme + learning centre + target semester and sets a pick DEADLINE through the Offering confirmation operations below; students see only those confirmed subjects and may pick until the deadline. The target semester is the NEXT semester after the system current semester managed by the System Administrator (Academic Semesters module, planned marker). Coordinators are ASSIGNED (admin-managed, planned) to faculty, programme and learning centre and act only within their assignments (403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED). The Coordinator sees, side by side with the forecast, the pick count AND the list of students who picked each subject (name, matric number, current semester, credits completed; ordering by seniority as a display aid) for the programme and centre in their assignment only; this reverses the earlier counts-only rule. Students never see other students' picks, and the data is never an input to the forecast calculation. The cycle ends when students have picked and the Coordinator sees the counts and pickers and decides (no automatic allocation): no class-section creation from picks, no registration, no timetable. Class sizes: LAB maximum 35, LECTURE (non-lab) maximum 45, optimal 25. Planned migrations target the development database (Neon development branch) only.

tags.name: Imports
tags.description: Single-file cohort upload and immutable accepted snapshots.

tags.name: Forecasts
tags.description: Initial advisory baseline, decisions and audit. A forecast (including FINALIZED) is advisory and publishes nothing; it helps the Coordinator decide which subjects to make available next semester.

tags.name: Configuration
tags.description: Forecast configuration for System Administrators only.

tags.name: Offering confirmation
tags.description: PLANNED. Coordinator confirmation of the subjects offered for a programme + learning centre + target (next) semester, and read-only student pick counts with the list of pickers per subject (assigned coordinators only). Confirmation is deliberate, audited, and is what students see as 'Confirmed by coordinator'.

get.summary: Read configured programme, centre, semester and curriculum options
get.description: Requires an active Coordinator. Returns configured programmes, centres and semesters. With programmeId, also returns that programme's configured curriculum versions, curriculum_subject -> subject catalogue, exclusions and prerequisite expressions/conditions. This endpoint never calls student/profile/options APIs.

200.description: UTF-8 CSV header in the defined field order.

get.summary: List import summaries in a required scope
get.description: Programme, centre and target semester filters are required. The list is paginated and returns metadata/counts, not raw CSV rows. Import list rows are summaries; use import detail to retrieve the full validation report and warnings.

post.summary: Validate one CSV and accept it when all rows are valid
post.description: Fully valid uploads are accepted directly, including warnings. Row errors return a 422 correction report without accepting rejected history. Valid roster metadata is retained when a subject-history row is invalid. The file is bound to programme, centre and target semester; the server verifies all IDs against configured catalogue rows. The caller actor is derived from the verified active Coordinator session. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts. CSV v1 accepts optional UTF-8 BOM, comma/double-quote escaping and LF/CRLF; trims fields, treats trimmed-empty as blank, compares opaque external references case-sensitively (1-128 Unicode characters), allows int32 positive semester IDs and nonnegative integer credits, and limits uploads to 5 MiB/10,000 data rows. A successful accepted-import response includes the complete validation report, including nonblocking warnings; warnings remain retrievable from import detail. No raw CSV is returned.

get.summary: Read import provenance and quality summary
get.description: Returns the scoped accepted import and complete validation quality report, including nonblocking warnings; never returns raw CSV.

post.summary: Accept remaining valid rows after explicit acknowledgement
post.description: Only available for a validation with row errors and valid rows remaining. If-Match binds acknowledgement to the validation report/fingerprint revision; the validation may be accepted once. This is the uploading Coordinator's acknowledgement, not a second-person policy approval. After authentication, an idempotent replay resolves to the original receipt before current validation state is checked. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts.

get.summary: List runs in a required programme/centre/semester scope

post.description: Requires an accepted import matching all three scope IDs. Creates version 1 with parent null. Supported eligible-pool demand is advisory, not registration. Missing evidence creates per-student/subject uncertainty; missing capacity creates CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED on affected sections. Neither blocks unrelated supported rows. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts.

get.summary: Read a run and its saved assumptions

post.summary: Review or adjust sections and append audit entries
post.description: Request carries all three scope IDs; server verifies them against the stored run. Requires If-Match and Idempotency-Key. Actor, before/after values and timestamp are server-derived. Changes and append-only audits commit atomically. An idempotent replay returns the original receipt after authentication, before the current revision is checked. Idempotency keys are server-namespaced by actor, operation and programme/centre/semester; key text need not embed scope. After auth, replay lookup precedes mutable state/revision checks. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts.

Request carries all scope IDs and they must match the stored run. Requires If-Match and Idempotency-Key. Validate required reviews, append the final audit, and freeze in one transaction. Finalization is advisory and does not itself publish or confirm any offering; the Coordinator confirms offerings as a separate, later step (see Offering confirmation operations). Idempotency keys are server-namespaced by actor, operation and programme/centre/semester; key text need not embed scope. After auth, replay lookup precedes mutable state/revision checks. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts. Finalization is allowed only from UNDER_REVIEW after required reviews; successful finalization records non-null actor/time and freezes the run.

get.summary: Read a bounded page of append-only decisions

get.description: Active System Administrator only. This role does not gain access to cohort imports or forecasts.

put.summary: Update capacity, exclusion and stale-source configuration
put.description: Active System Administrator only. Requires If-Match and Idempotency-Key. The API never seeds provisional capacity numbers. The new version appends configuration and never mutates rows referenced by existing runs. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts.

post.summary: Move an initial draft into review
post.description: Explicit DRAFT to UNDER_REVIEW transition. Scope must match the stored run. Requires If-Match and Idempotency-Key. Replay lookup follows authentication and precedes current state/revision checks. Idempotency keys are server-namespaced by actor, operation and programme/centre/semester; key text need not embed scope. After auth, replay lookup precedes mutable state/revision checks. After current authorization, replay lookup returns the original receipt before mutable resource state or ETag/revision checks; same key with a different payload conflicts.

get.summary: PLANNED: read the confirmed offerings for a programme + centre + target semester
get.description: Active Coordinator only. Returns the latest confirmation state per subject (CONFIRMED and WITHDRAWN) and the set revision (also as ETag). The latest confirmation for the scope is authoritative and is what students see. The target semester is the next semester for the students served. Private, no-store. Coordinator scope: the authenticated Coordinator must be assigned (admin-managed, planned) to the programme and learning centre; otherwise 403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED.

post.description: Active Coordinator only. A deliberate action, never automatic. Requires a FINALIZED forecast run for the same programme + centre + target semester (recorded as provenance); excluded subjects (FYP, Industrial Training, non-classroom) cannot be confirmed; a WITHDRAWN subject may be re-confirmed. A non-blank reason is required and a pick deadline (pickDeadline, future date-time; send the current one on re-confirmation) is part of the confirmation: students can pick and change picks only until it, after which picks are closed (read-only). Actor and time are derived server-side and appended to the audit atomically with the state change. The request carries baseRevision (null when no confirmation exists); a stale revision returns 412. Idempotency-Key replays return the original receipt. Students then see these subjects as 'Confirmed by coordinator'; this is not official registration and not a guaranteed timetable. Forecasts and pick counts are not changed by this operation. A new forecast run/version never changes, invalidates or requires re-confirmation of existing confirmations (decided); the confirmation only keeps forecastRunId as provenance. Coordinator scope: the authenticated Coordinator must be assigned (admin-managed, planned) to the programme and learning centre; otherwise 403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED.

Active Coordinator only. Marks the listed subjects WITHDRAWN for the scope with a required reason, audited atomically. Withdrawn subjects disappear from the student list; existing student picks for them are kept but excluded from the student's list and from pick counts (OP7). Requires baseRevision (stale returns 412) and Idempotency-Key. Coordinator scope: the authenticated Coordinator must be assigned (admin-managed, planned) to the programme and learning centre; otherwise 403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED.

get.summary: PLANNED: audit of confirm and withdraw actions in a scope
get.description: Active Coordinator only. Append-only entries with actor, time, reason and before/after status. Bounded by limit/cursor. Coordinator scope: the authenticated Coordinator must be assigned (admin-managed, planned) to the programme and learning centre; otherwise 403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED.

get.summary: PLANNED: student pick counts and pickers per subject for a scope
get.description: Active assigned Coordinator only. Per subject, the COUNT of student picks and the LIST of students who picked it, for programme + learning centre + target (next) semester, shown side by side with the forecast. Decided 2026-11-01: coordinators manage the students of their assigned centre and need to see who picked (this replaces importing names and untaken subjects from the student management system), so that senior students can be prioritised to graduate sooner. Only students whose profile programme + learning centre fall within the coordinator's assignment are returned; otherwise 403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED. No small-number suppression. Pickers carry studentId (profile ID, never a Clerk ID), studentName, matricNo, currentSemester, creditsCompleted and the planned intakeSemester. The default order is by seniority (decided 2026-11-01: credits completed toward the curriculum, highest first; tie-break the earliest intake, then the current semester); this is a display aid, the coordinator decides and nothing is allocated automatically. Students never see other students' picks. Display only: not an input to the forecast calculation. Each entry also carries classType and implied classes (ceil(picks / maximum), LAB 35 / LECTURE 45) against optimal 25 as a display aid. The cycle ends here: no class sections from picks, no registration, no timetable. Private, no-store; personal data must not be cached in shared caches or logged. Coordinator scope: the authenticated Coordinator must be assigned to the programme and learning centre. The seniority ordering is display-aid policy version 1, revisable by a new change record and an update to the single shared helper; no migration because ordering is computed, never stored.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of pickers within each subject; display aid.

post.summary: PLANNED: change the pick deadline for a scope
post.description: Active assigned Coordinator. Sets the date-time after which students can no longer pick or change picks for the programme + learning centre + target semester (replaces the Google Form practice). A future date-time and a reason are required; actor and time are derived server-side and the change is audited (action SET_DEADLINE) atomically. Requires baseRevision (stale returns 412) and Idempotency-Key. Coordinator scope: the authenticated Coordinator must be assigned (admin-managed, planned) to the programme and learning centre; otherwise 403 SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNED.

ETag.description: Opaque current revision used with If-Match.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Server namespaces by authenticated actor, operation and programme/centre/semester scope.

classType.description: May be null when the canonical subject class_type is absent.

file.description: UTF-8 CSV with optional BOM, comma delimiting, doubled-quote escaping, LF or CRLF. Trim surrounding spaces; trimmed-empty is blank. At most 5 MiB and 10,000 data rows.

external_reference.description: Opaque case-sensitive source reference, 1 to 128 Unicode characters; never a portal identity.

curriculum_version.description: Blank only with exactly one configured programme curriculum version.

cohort_status.description: ACTIVE has a provisional engineering mapping to supported potential demand. Unrecognized tokens are per-student uncertainty.

subject_code.description: Blank only when the five-field attempt group is empty.

subject_status.description: Blank only when all five attempt fields are blank. WITHDRAWN is not normalized.

record_semester_id.description: Positive decimal int32 lexeme; implementations must reject numeric values above 2147483647.

recognized_credits.description: Nonnegative decimal integer no greater than verified catalogue credit hours. FAILED and IN_PROGRESS accept blank or 0 only; positive recognized credit on either is invalid.

is_synthetic.description: Blank only for a no-history row.

forecastCount.description: Null is unknown; never encode as zero.

ForecastRun.description: Checked constraint: status FINALIZED requires non-null finalizedBy/finalizedAt; DRAFT and UNDER_REVIEW require both null. Finalized runs are immutable.

oneOf.description: subjectId is the canonical subject.subject_id, not curriculum_subject_id.

replacementSections.description: Full replacement allocation for the subject. Omitted existing section IDs retire those sections from the current allocation; historical section/audit rows are retained.

oneOf.description: subjectId is the canonical subject.subject_id, not curriculum_subject_id.

effectiveToSemesterId.description: Null means no end semester; otherwise a positive canonical int32 ID.

CapacityRule.description: Decided 2026-11-01: two class types, LAB (normalMaximum 35) and LECTURE/non-lab (normalMaximum 45); optimal class size 25 is the breakEvenTarget. Entered as configuration, not seeded. Earlier example values 40 / 30 / 35 are withdrawn.

effectiveToSemesterId.description: Null means no end semester; otherwise a positive canonical int32 ID.

SubjectExclusion.description: subjectId is a positive canonical int32 ID from the subject catalogue. Effective semester IDs are positive canonical int32 IDs from the shared configured semester catalogue. Effective ranges use configured academic-year/term chronology, never numeric ID order; a non-null end must not precede its start.

staleSourceMaxAgeDays.description: Null means no configured threshold; emit a warning.

ForecastConfigurationRequest.description: Create a new immutable configuration version/active pointer; never mutate capacity rows referenced by a forecast.

CurriculumRequirementSnapshot.description: Mirrors curriculum_requirement; required_subjects is a nullable nonnegative count, not an ID list.

forecastRunId.description: FINALIZED run the confirmation was based on (provenance).

revision.description: Null before the first confirmation for the scope.

pickDeadline.description: Deadline after which student picks are closed; null before the first confirmation.

newerForecastAvailable.description: Informational display aid: a newer forecast run exists for the same programme + centre + semester. No automatic effect on the confirmation.

pickDeadline.description: Pick deadline. Students may pick or change picks only until this time.

pickers.description: Length equals pickCount. Seniority order by default.

pickDeadline.description: Picks are closed (read-only) after this time.

OfferingPickCountSummary.description: Pick counts and the list of pickers per subject, for an assigned Coordinator only. Display only; not an input to the forecast calculation; no automatic allocation.

ImpliedClasses.description: Display aid only; not a class-section proposal and not a forecast input.

averageSizeAtMaximum.description: picks / classesAtMaximum, to compare with the optimal size 25.

OfferingPicker.description: A student who picked the subject, shown to an assigned Coordinator only.

studentId.description: student_profile.student_id; never a Clerk user ID.

intakeSemester.description: PLANNED field (P001); no intake is stored today, null until recorded.

creditsCompleted.description: Sum of recognized credits of COMPLETED/EXEMPTED academic records toward the curriculum; null when unavailable.

ImportAcceptedResponse.description: Accepted immutable import or its summary; no-store.

ImportValidationResponse.description: 422 correction report. No invalid history is accepted. No-store; ETag binds a later subset acknowledgement.

ForecastRunResponse.description: Forecast and saved assumptions; no-store; ETag identifies its revision.

ForecastOperationResponse.description: Operation receipt. Replays return the original receipt, not the current mutable resource.

Forbidden.description: Active identity lacks the required verified role.

ScopeNotFound.description: Resource or configured scope unavailable; mismatched IDs are not disclosed.

Conflict.description: Idempotency mismatch, existing initial run or lifecycle conflict.

InvalidDecision.description: Decision/configuration is invalid for current state or rules.

Unavailable.description: Retryable dependency failure; SQL/provider details are not exposed.

ConfirmedOfferingSetResponse.description: Latest confirmation state per subject for the scope; no-store.

OfferingPickCountResponse.description: Pick counts and pickers per subject (assigned coordinator only); contains personal data; no-store.
